title: Tunes written for Harry James
summary: The Sphinx and You Can't Have Your Cake were written in the James years; Robbins published the latter.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: Was there anything else you wrote for James, because I don't have a James discography. Did you do anything else besides these numbers? Did you write any new numbers that Harry James recorded that had not been done by Duke?
You wrote // You Can't Have Your Cake and Eat It, Too, // while you were with Harry James, didn't you Juan?
Yeah. I recorded that with my own small group, and Willie Smith sang the lyrics.
Yes, I think you mentioned that before. Who published the tunes you wrote when you were with Harry?
// You Can't Have Your Cake and Eat It? //
